_doc: The film camera (docs/interactives_backlog.md item 2; engine: Private/Photo/LyudPhoto.cpp). The photo studios' service: handing in an exposed film and collecting the prints (photo_lab, the screen "photo_lab", at the studio's own darkroom behind the screen, photographer on shift; the engine takes the money and keeps the films). The hero's own developing is the screen "photo_darkroom" on the darkroom acts (activities.json darkroom, x_p_club3.json cog_darkroom). The camera and the films are sold at the studio's desk (counters.json shop photo, stories.json photo_desk). The album's three stamp sets are given by the game's code ("by": "code", ULyudCityThings::GiveStamp when a film is developed with a sharp frame of the subject): photo_birds = the species ids of Content/BirdsData/species.json, photo_sky = sunset_<weather regime> (ELyudWeatherRegime in snake case) and aurora, photo_life = fest_<festival id of Content/PeopleData/festivals.json>, fish, maru; a new species or festival is added here by hand. The quest city_portrait («Портрет города») is given by the photographer (topic photo.city, talk.json) and hears the event photo <map place> when a developed film has a frame taken there. Strings: strings/photo.json.
